wxsxhnyc.sourceDescription: Our MD's favourite! With a classic upturned shape and incorporating super lifelike PE plastic moulded branch tips, we love the final look of this realistic 6ft Christmas tree. 8wxrmpaj.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Fairy Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Black - 150 cm
8wxrmpaj.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Fairy Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Black - 150 cm
8wxrmpaj.sourceDescription: This cone-shaped PVC Artificial Christmas Tree brings modern elegance to your seasonal decor with its sleek and simple design. It enhances any living space or garden, creating a festive presence with minimal ornamentation and maximum impact. Its visually appealing structure can serve as a centerpiece for gatherings, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere while maintaining a stylish appearance that aligns with contemporary aesthetics. Quality PVC Build The tree is constructed from high-quality PVC, known for its durability and weather resistance, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. The material ensures longevity while mimicking the lush, evergreen foliage of a real tree, lending a natural look to your decor. Versatile LED Lighting Equipped with flexible LED strip lights, this tree offers warm white illumination that can be adapted to various settings. The USB connection allows for convenient powering options, enabling usage in multiple environments without the need for traditional power adapters. Modern Design With clean lines and a minimalist form, it fits seamlessly into modern decor styles. The understated elegance enhances any space, allowing you to decorate creatively with ornaments or lights for a personalized touch. Easy Installation Requires simple assembly with a screwdriver, accommodating those with minimal DIY experience. The straightforward setup ensures that your holiday preparation is stress-free so you can focus on the festive activities. Indoor &Outdoor Use Suitable for living rooms, gardens, and terraces, this tree adds charm both inside and outside. Its weather-resistant build makes it a flexible addition to your holiday decorations, approachable for various settings and scenarios. Product Specifications Colour: Black Material: PVC Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 75 cm Stand size: 35 x 35 cm Hinged construction for set up lightweight and break-resistant Number of PVC tips: 380 Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 1000 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

vtr6m6xn.baseName: Neo 50cm Christmas Wreath with Frosted Foliage Pine Cones White Berries
vtr6m6xn.variantName: Neo 50cm Christmas Wreath with Frosted Foliage Pine Cones White Berries
vtr6m6xn.sourceDescription: Bring festive charm to your home with this decorative Christmas wreath, beautifully arranged with a rich combination of natural-style pine cones, frosted detailing, evergreen foliage, pink wooden accents and soft white berry decorations. The layered design creates a full, textured appearance that adds warmth and character to both traditional and contemporary Christmas décor. Perfect for styling throughout the festive season, this Christmas door wreath can be displayed on a front door, internal door, above a fireplace or as part of a Christmas table centrepiece. The combination of rustic pine cones, wintry frosted finishes and distinctive pink accents gives the wreath a modern twist on classic seasonal decorations. Designed to be enjoyed year after year, it makes an eye-catching addition to your home or a thoughtful festive gift. •Festive Christmas Wreath - An attractive seasonal decoration featuring pine cones, foliage, white berries and colourful wooden accents for a full, decorative finish. •Rustic Frosted Design - Natural-style pine cones with white frosted tips create a charming snow-dusted winter appearance. Distinctive Pink Accents - Pink wooden decorative pieces add a contemporary splash of colour, making this wreath stand out from traditional Christmas •decorations. •Versatile Christmas Decoration - Ideal as a Christmas door wreath, fireplace decoration, wall display or festive table centrepiece. •Suitable for a Range of Interiors - Complements rustic, farmhouse, Scandi, traditional and modern Christmas decorating themes. •H 50 x W 50 x D 9.3cm This product is intended for decorative purposes only and is not a toy. Keep out of reach of young children and pets. Small or detachable decorative components, including berries, wooden pieces, foliage and pine cone fragments, may present a choking hazard. Keep away from naked flames, candles, heaters and other heat or ignition sources. Ensure the wreath is securely attached when hung on a door, wall or above a fireplace to prevent it from falling. Do not place directly above or close to an active fireplace. Inspect regularly and discontinue use if damaged or if components become loose. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use. Neo Direct Ltd. Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW
